// Emscripten 6.0.9 updateGOT reference; retained for differential loader tests.
var lasmMainExports;
var getEmptyTableSlot = () => {
  if (freeTableIndexes.length) {
    return freeTableIndexes.pop();
  }
  return wasmTable["grow"](1);
};
var updateGOT = (exports, replace) => {
  for (var symName in exports) {
    if (isInternalSym(symName)) {
      continue;
    }
    var value = exports[symName];
    var existingEntry = GOT[symName] && GOT[symName].value != -1n;
    if (replace || !existingEntry) {
      var newValue;
      if (typeof value == "function") {
        newValue = BigInt(addFunction(value));
      } else if (typeof value.value == "bigint") {
        newValue = value;
      } else {
        continue;
      }
      GOT[symName] ??= new WebAssembly.Global({
        "value": "i64",
        "mutable": true
      });
      GOT[symName].value = newValue;
    }
  }
};
